headline: Trafigura Increases Copper Purchases in Asia Amid Supply Shortage
summary: Trafigura Group is acquiring large volumes of copper to boost sales in Asia as local supplies tighten. The scramble for the metal has pushed regional spot premiums to record highs.
why: Trafigura is one of the world's largest independent commodity trading houses. Copper is a critical industrial metal, and supply constraints in major manufacturing hubs like Asia can signal broader industrial demand shifts.

impacts.name: Copper
impacts.why: Increased buying activity and supply shortages typically drive spot premiums and futures prices higher.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: The combination of low local supply and aggressive buying by a major trader creates a physical shortage, forcing buyers to pay record premiums.
